inspiration.observed_pattern: EXCEPT ALL subtracts duplicate multiplicity from a left relation while a DISTINCT right operand first collapses its own repeated values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent entitlement reconciliation. Requested entitlement rows intentionally repeat codes, while the blocked relation repeats some codes too; EXCEPT ALL against SELECT DISTINCT removes one occurrence per distinct blocked code and preserves remaining request multiplicity. The source tables, identifiers, values, and conformance data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Requested code alpha appears twice, beta once, and gamma once. The blocked relation repeats alpha and gamma; DISTINCT on the right collapses those repeats, so one alpha, beta, and no gamma remain after EXCEPT ALL.
determinism_notes: Request and block IDs and labels are fixed, and the set result is explicitly ordered by entitlement code. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE requested_entitlements (request_id INT PRIMARY KEY, entitlement_code VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE blocked_entitlements (block_id INT PRIMARY KEY, entitlement_code VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT entitlement_code FROM requested_entitlements EXCEPT ALL SELECT DISTINCT entitlement_code FROM blocked_entitlements ORDER BY entitlement_code
